description: This file defines the internal sealed class TenantHttpClientFactory, which implements IHttpClientFactory, IHttpMessageHandlerFactory, and IDisposable. It manages creation, lifecycle, and cleanup of HttpClient handlers, including handling active and expired handlers, with cleanup timers and logging.

classes.name: TenantHttpClientFactory
classes.description: Manages creation, lifecycle, and cleanup of HttpClient handlers with support for active and expired handler management, cleanup timers, and logging.

methods.name: CreateClient
methods.description: Creates an HttpClient with a specified handler name, applying configured actions.

methods.name: CreateHandler
methods.description: Creates or retrieves a message handler for a given client name, starting its expiry timer.

methods.name: CreateHandlerEntry
methods.description: Internal method to create a new ActiveHandlerTrackingEntry, configuring the handler with filters and builder actions.

methods.name: ExpiryTimer_Tick
methods.description: Handles expiry of active handlers, moving them to expired handlers queue and logging expiration.

methods.name: StartHandlerEntryTimer
methods.description: Starts the expiry timer for a handler entry.

methods.name: StartCleanupTimer
methods.description: Starts the cleanup timer for expired handlers.

methods.name: CleanupTimer_Tick
methods.description: Performs cleanup of expired handlers, disposing of handlers that can be disposed, and reschedules cleanup if needed.

methods.name: Dispose
methods.description: Disposes the factory, active handlers, and triggers cleanup of remaining handlers.
